title: Restore Brain evidence projection and activate anomaly intelligence
problem: Brain Hub read an unowned evidencePack.items field while the canonical evidence builder exposed typed source arrays; anomaly scanning existed without a Brain portfolio caller.
decision: Project a typed items view from the canonical evidence builder and let the Brain algorithm access service optionally scan the current VT-SYNC snapshot, map only channel-scoped anomalies, and pass them through the existing anomaly bridge.
tracePath: VT-SYNC -> analytics-canon -> anomaly scan -> ExternalAnomalySignal -> Algorithm Intelligence portfolio -> Brain Hub
creatorDecision: Make Brain evidence visible and surface material unusual changes as explainable intelligence without automatic external action.
unknowns: No causal claim is made from an anomaly alone.
Opportunity intelligence remains empty until its evidence producer is connected.
Outcome and evaluation ledgers remain downstream follow-up work.
evaluationPlan: Compare anomaly counts and unsupported-claim behavior before/after
approval: No publish or external write is introduced; recommendation handoffs remain approval-aware.
nextAction: Run verification, publish draft PR, request review; do not merge or deploy without approval.
visual: not applicable; existing Brain Hub layout preserved
